inputs.name: DeviceConnectionService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Provides the paired-device credentials, wire client metadata, socket-opening callback, and optional wire client and handshake timeout used by connect. The timeout defaults to remoteLimits.handshakeDeadlineMs (10,000 ms); when wire is omitted, the service creates WireClientService({ client: options.client }).

inputs.name: DeviceConnectionService.onStatus.listener
inputs.description: Receives the next reported DeviceStatus (online, offline, or revoked) and subsequent changes; unchanged statuses are suppressed.

outputs.name: DeviceConnectionService.onStatus
outputs.description: Returns a disposer function that removes this listener from the service; registration does not immediately report the current status.

outputs.name: DeviceConnectionService.connect
outputs.description: Resolves to the RemoteAttachment returned by wire.bind after the socket opens, an accept packet arrives, and wire attachment succeeds; handshake waits default to remoteLimits.handshakeDeadlineMs (10,000 ms) unless handshakeMs is set. Error, SecureFailure, or RemoteFailure can reject setup, and a later host-online relay notice starts another handshake on the same socket.

outputs.name: DeviceConnectionService.close
outputs.description: Returns no value; when a socket is active, it closes it with code 1000 and reports offline if the status changes. With no active socket it does nothing.

errors.name: Device handshake timeout or unexpected response
errors.description: The service creates Error when a handshake times out or the host response is not an accept packet; setup errors from dependencies are rethrown unchanged.

errors.name: SecureFailure
errors.description: SecureChannelService rejects invalid handshake state, handshake packets, or key derivation with SecureFailure; DeviceConnectionService propagates it from handshake setup.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: WireClientService.bind rejects RemoteFailure when attachment is offline, times out, or receives a host attach failure; DeviceConnectionService propagates that rejection.
